title: nsm-definition template variables
description: Values for templates/nsm-definition.md.j2 and templates/nsm-definition.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from nsm-definition.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

current_value.title: Current value
current_value.description: Today's value with the date it was read. A North Star without a starting point cannot show movement, and nobody will remember what it was when this is reviewed next quarter.

customer_value_link.title: Customer value link
customer_value_link.description: How this metric represents value the customer received, not effort you expended. If it goes up when customers are doing more work for the same outcome, you have picked a vanity metric.

date.title: Date
date.description: Validation Test Results (last run. From section 'Dashboard Link'.

nsm_calculation.title: Nsm calculation
nsm_calculation.description: The exact calculation - the population, the action, the window. "Count of unique teams that completed at least one task in the last 7 days". Anyone with database access must be able to reproduce your number from this sentence alone.

nsm_name.title: Nsm name
nsm_name.description: The metric's short name, said the way the team will say it in a standup - "Weekly Active Teams". Not a formula and not an acronym nobody expands.

revenue_hypothesis.title: Revenue hypothesis
revenue_hypothesis.description: The evidence or hypothesis that this predicts revenue - a cohort correlation you measured, or the untested belief stated as untested. Say which of the two it is.

target_value.title: Target value
target_value.description: The value you are aiming for and the date you expect it. Pick a date close enough that being wrong is embarrassing while the people who set it are still here.

yes_no_inconclusive.title: Yes no inconclusive
yes_no_inconclusive.description: NSM up → retention up. From section 'Validation Test Results (last run'.
